decks.notes: This deck focuses on aggressive creature cards and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent while utilizing mana acceleration from cards like Arbor Elf and Birds of Paradise. The commander, Klothys, God of Destiny, helps to provide additional burn and graveyard hate, making it difficult for the opponent to stabilize. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early on and maintain that pressure throughout the game, using cards like Questing Beast and Glorybringer to deliver impactful attacks. With a mix of efficient creatures and versatile burn spells, the deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent to secure a quick victory in the 1 vs 1 Duel Commander format.

This deck focuses on controlling the board and disrupting the opponent's strategy while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures. The commander, Raffine, Scheming Seer, is used to generate card advantage and maintain a tempo advantage. The deck includes a mix of disruptive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Meddling Mage, along with efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Fatal Push. It also utilizes versatile counter spells such as Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect its own threats. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistent access to the resources needed to execute its game plan effectively.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize the powerful abilities of Commander Rafiq of the Many to create a fast and aggressive playstyle. The deck features a combination of efficient mana rampers like Birds of Paradise, Llanowar Elves, and Noble Hierarch to quickly generate mana and enable early game threats. It also includes a variety of protection and evasion spells to enhance the Commander's combat capabilities, such as Blossoming Defense, Berserk, and Gryff's Boon. Additionally, the deck incorporates disruptive elements like Meddling Mage and Ranger-Captain of Eos to control the opponent's actions. Overall, the deck aims to quickly establish a dominant board presence and overwhelm the opponent with its aggressive strategy.

This deck is focused on controlling the game by using a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to disrupt the opponent's plans and maintain board control. The commander, Shorikai, Genesis Engine, provides additional card advantage and flexibility to adapt to different situations. The deck also includes powerful spells such as Cryptic Command, Supreme Verdict, and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria to deal with threats and generate advantage. By effectively managing resources and maintaining tempo, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and ultimately win through card advantage and superior board presence. Additionally, the deck includes a versatile mana base and a mix of interactive spells to handle a variety of threats effectively.

The Isamaru, Hound of Konda deck focuses on building a strong aggro strategy with a mix of efficient creatures, disruptive spells, and powerful equipment. The deck aims to put early pressure on the opponent with a fast start from low-cost creatures like Isamaru, Adanto Vanguard, and Mirran Crusader. It also includes disruptive elements like Leonin Arbiter, Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, and Archon of Emeria to slow down the opponent's game plan. The deck utilizes powerful equipment like Umezawa's Jitte, Sword of Fire and Ice, and Skullclamp to boost its creatures and generate card advantage. Overall, the deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and aggressive game plan while disrupting their strategy with disruptive elements.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of aggressive creatures, burn spells, and sacrifice effects to quickly deal damage to the opponent and control the game. Cards like Goblin Guide, Bonecrusher Giant, and Judith, the Scourge Diva provide early pressure while cards like Lightning Bolt and Fatal Push can take out opposing threats. Sacrifice outlets like Carrion Feeder and Village Rites can fuel cards like Deadly Rollick and Reanimate to bring back key creatures. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the key strategy is to apply early pressure, control the board with removal spells, and finish off the opponent with burn or sacrifice effects.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. With Shorikai, Genesis Engine as the commander, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while gradually building up its own board presence. The deck includes a variety of counterspells like Counterspell, Force of Will, and Dovin's Veto to stop key spells from resolving. Removal spells such as Swords to Plowshares and Cleansing Nova deal with problematic permanents on the battlefield. Card advantage is achieved through cards like Jace, the Mind Sculptor, Fact or Fiction, and Snapcaster Mage. The goal is to outvalue the opponent and ultimately control the game until a win condition like Celestial Colonnade or Shark Typhoon can take over.

This deck is focused on playing creatures quickly and efficiently to overrun the opponent with a high-powered board state. By utilizing ramp spells like Utopia Sprawl and Wild Growth, the deck aims to get creatures on the battlefield early and often. The inclusion of cards like Garruk, Unleashed and Vivien, Arkbow Ranger provide additional support and card advantage while also pumping up your creatures. With a wide range of powerful creatures like Questing Beast, Thrun, the Last Troll, and Vengevine, the deck is able to apply pressure on the opponent while maintaining a resilient board presence. The ultimate goal is to overwhelm the opponent with big creatures and efficient plays to secure a victory.
